turns.text: I was actually hoping to meet more people from other departments.
turns.zh: 其实我一直希望能多认识一些其他部门的人。

turns.text: So, how's your first week going?
turns.zh: 那，你第一周过得怎么样？

turns.text: I remember feeling completely lost when I started here 6 months ago.
turns.zh: 我记得我六个月前刚来这儿的时候，完全找不着北。

turns.text: Honestly, it's been overwhelming but exciting at the same time.
turns.zh: 说实话，压力挺大的，但同时也挺兴奋的。

turns.text: Everyone seems really nice and the office culture is way more relaxed than my last job.
turns.zh: 大家看起来都特别好，而且办公室氛围比我上一份工作轻松多了。

turns.text: Where were you working before this?
